sourceRoster.description: Reusable fantasy location archetypes for D&D-style adventures. Frequency tiers are editorial estimates, not measured campaign statistics. Named campaign-specific places can extend this catalog.

artDirection.normal: Original cinematic painterly fantasy environment illustration, believable materials and architecture, wide establishing shot, readable at small display sizes. The location is the subject; any inhabitants are incidental and do not imply a specific party or encounter. No text, labels, UI, map grid, collage, borders, logos or watermark.
artDirection.yolo: Same environment illustration style and recognizable location type, with an original absurd dark-comedy visual twist. Describe the visible joke explicitly in the variant description. No meme captions, text, UI, map grid, collage, borders, logos or watermark.

selectionGuidance: Match the scene to a location ID using its English description and tags.
Use normal variants by default. Use yolo variants only when the caller explicitly requests that tone.
Choose only existing entries in variants; target counts and pending locations are not available artwork.
Then match the variant's English description, tags, lighting and mood to the current scene.
Join assetBaseUrl with the selected variant's relative path. Keep the existing fallback when no suitable generated variant is available.

visualAuthoring.authorship: Original authored visual constraints added to the catalog; not inferred facts about any live campaign.
visualAuthoring.consumerStatus: Opt-in authoring metadata for an external narrator or image-generation operator. This addition does not integrate automatic runtime selection or rendering.
visualAuthoring.existingArtwork: Existing variant descriptions, files, review results and provenance remain unchanged. Existing review results predate visualSpec and do not certify compliance with these new constraints. Review the actual image and full variant description before use.
visualAuthoring.normalPromptSource: locations[id].visualSpec.imageSafePrompt is a complete default normal archetype prompt. It is not a prompt for every already generated variant.
visualAuthoring.variantPrecedence: For a chosen existing variant, its description/tags/lighting/mood describe that specific image. provenance.prompt records the historical generation request and must not be rewritten as current metadata. Never infer that arbitrary archetype optional features are visible in an existing image.

resolveBeforeClaimingExactMatch: public location identity and campaign setting
visible connections, door counts and layout
season, time of day, weather and current visible damage
which inhabitants are publicly present and whether they should appear
campaignAdaptation.precedence: Authorized public campaign facts override authored catalog defaults. If facts conflict with defining features, select another archetype or author a new campaign-specific scene rather than mislabel this one.
campaignAdaptation.unknowns: Do not invent fixed coordinates, compass directions, exact dimensions, named settlements, factions or neighboring landmarks. Omit unresolved details or mark an explicitly authored proposal for review.
campaignAdaptation.privacy: Use only currently observable or already revealed facts. Do not pass GM-only notes, hidden doors, trap solutions, secret occupants, unrevealed treasure or future outcomes to an image model.

composition.purpose: One environment establishing illustration; not a tactical map or a guarantee of playable geometry
composition.population: Environment is primary. Do not invent a specific party, enemy, encounter or outcome; any explicitly selected incidental inhabitants stay subordinate.

variantInputs.normal: Choose public optional details, lighting, weather and time without contradicting the required features or campaign facts. The stored imageSafePrompt avoids unsolicited optional landmarks.
variantInputs.yolo: Require explicit caller approval of the tone and an explicit visible comic twist. Start from this location visualSpec plus artDirection.yolo and the selected existing variant description, or an authored new twist. Retain the recognizable location type. Reconcile deliberate absurd departures from normal exclusions individually; never silently promote a normal prompt to YOLO or disclose a story secret as the joke.

visualAuthoring.consistency: For repeated depictions of one campaign location, freeze a separately approved public layout and feature palette and reuse its reviewed reference images. This catalog provides no campaign instance, coordinates or image references for pending artwork.
